assumptions: Cold pair (score_cold = warm + score_warm): 20 crops x 2 images through the trunk; the ref head on the reference crops, the dist head on the distorted crops. A warm reference removes the 20 reference trunk passes and the ref heads.

MACs from models/common/count_macs.py (onnx shape inference; agrees exactly with zenmetrics--cxswe2 scripts/complexity/onnx_macs.py on ahiq_pyiqa_ref/dist, which onnx_macs.py can read; it fails on the trunk graph): trunk 33,414,880,768 per 224^2 crop (ViT-B/8 blocks 0-4 MatMul 32,513,318,400; ResNet-50 stem + layer1 Conv 901,562,368); ref head 25,071,943,680; dist head 33,294,786,560. Constant per crop whatever W,H (fixed-NN convention: elements = crops).

Element ops counted: GridSample 21,676,032 bilinear taps per head call (4 mul + 3 add each), Relu, Sigmoid (exp+add+div), from onnx_macs.py on the heads. Trunk element ops (LayerNorm, softmax, GELU) are not counted (onnx_macs.py cannot parse the trunk graph); a lower bound.
Images with min(W,H) <= 224 are first bilinear-upscaled to 225 on the short side; not modelled in the elements formulas (stage upscale is 0 for the evaluated shapes).
